sentences.en: The past two years have been a difficult time for most Americans, but they have taken a particularly heavy toll on the health, mental health,

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听美国心理学会的旗舰播客《心理学谈话》，本节目旨在探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: Our guest today is Dr. Rihanna Elise Anderson.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾是里安娜·埃莉斯·安德森博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Anderson is a licensed clinical psychologist and an assistant professor in the Department of Health, Behavior,
sentences.zh: 安德森博士是一位执业临床心理学家，也是密歇根大学公共卫生学院健康行为与健康教育系的助理教授。

sentences.en: and Health Education at the University of Michigan School of Public Health.
sentences.zh: 她研究种族歧视如何影响黑人儿童和家庭，并开发干预措施以减轻种族压力和创伤，改善心理健康。

sentences.en: She studies how racial discrimination affects black children and families, and she develops interventions to reduce racial stress and trauma and improve psychological well-being.
sentences.zh: 安德森博士是EMBRACE项目的开发者和负责人，该项目代表“通过种族进行参与、管理和联结”。

sentences.en: Dr. Anderson is the developer and director of the EMBRACE program, which stands for Engaging, Managing, and Bonding Through Race.
sentences.zh: 她经常在媒体上谈论种族主义和心理健康问题，并接受过CNN、《公共电视网新闻一小时》和《纽约时报》等众多媒体的采访。

sentences.en: She speaks frequently to the media about racism and mental health and has been interviewed by CNN, the PBS NewsHour, and the New York Times, among many other media outlets.

sentences.en: And I'll reflect back to a talk that I was able to give at my grandparents' former church.
sentences.zh: 我会回顾一下我能够在我祖父母以前的教堂所做的一次演讲。

sentences.en: So, my grandparents are no longer with us.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母已经不在了。

sentences.en: But I got a request from them, the church, and I went to this very traditional Black church in Detroit and remembered growing up there and seeing all of these churchgoers,
sentences.zh: 但我收到了他们的请求，我去了底特律那座非常传统的黑人教堂，回想起在那里长大的经历，看到了所有这些礼拜者，

sentences.en: these parishioners, who I could recall some of the messages that are consistent with what you're saying coming out of the church.
sentences.zh: 这些教区居民，我能回想起一些与你所说的来自教堂的信息一致的内容。

sentences.en: And here I am being asked to talk about reduction of stigma in May for Mental Health Awareness Month.
sentences.zh: 而我被要求在五月份的“心理健康意识月”谈论减少污名化的问题。

sentences.en: And I share with them analogies, and that's the way that I teach generally when I'm talking to people,
sentences.zh: 我与他们分享了类比，这也是我通常在与人交谈时的教学方式，

sentences.en: whether it be in media in the classroom or 90-year-old grandmothers in the church, right?
sentences.zh: 无论是在媒体、课堂上，还是在教堂里对90岁的祖母们，对吧？

sentences.en: I use analogies, and I start talking about mechanics.
sentences.zh: 我使用类比，我开始谈论机械师。

sentences.en: And if you've been to Detroit and you've experienced some of our potholes and you know your car hits those potholes, you're going to need to see a mechanic pretty soon.
sentences.zh: 如果你去过底特律，经历过我们的一些坑洼，你知道你的车撞到那些坑洼时，你很快就需要找个机械师。

sentences.en: And you know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: I certainly don't have the skill set of a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 我肯定没有机械师的技能。

sentences.en: If I opened up the hood, if I popped the hood and I went in there with my blunt tools and my nascent understanding, there's going to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 如果我打开引擎盖，如果我掀开引擎盖，用我笨拙的工具和初步的理解去捣鼓，那肯定会出问题。

sentences.en: If I tried to fix the axle, it'll probably fall off the next time I drive the car.
sentences.zh: 如果我试图修理车轴，下次开车时它可能会掉下来。

sentences.en: So me trying to use my own skills or asking someone who is a dentist to take a look at my car, these are not skills that we're keen on, that we are able to utilize to fix this car.
sentences.zh: 所以试图用我自己的技能，或者让牙医去检查我的车，这些都不是我们擅长的、能够用来修理这辆车的技能。

sentences.en: So when we're thinking about what a pastor does, a pastor does very great work in our churches, in our spaces, and it goes beyond pastoral care, right?
sentences.zh: 所以当我们思考牧师做什么时，牧师在我们的教堂、我们的空间里做了非常伟大的工作，这超越了牧养关怀，对吧？

sentences.en: This goes to mentorship as well.
sentences.zh: 这也涉及到指导。

sentences.en: This goes to a number of in-house things that people might try to do.
sentences.zh: 这也涉及到人们可能尝试在内部解决的许多事情。

sentences.en: So the people we rely on to get our needs met can do them in ways that we are grateful for and have appreciation for.
sentences.zh: 所以我们依赖来满足需求的人，可以用我们感激和赞赏的方式来做这些事。

sentences.en: And people who have unique skill sets and are licensed in particular to utilize those skill sets have to abide by a set of laws,
sentences.zh: 而那些拥有独特技能并获得特定许可来利用这些技能的人，必须遵守一套法律，

sentences.en: have to abide by a set of ethos and values that are going to be better for your care in this area in the long run.
sentences.zh: 必须遵守一套道德和价值观，从长远来看，这对你在该领域的护理会更好。

sentences.en: So I certainly don't say that pastors aren't important.
sentences.zh: 所以我当然不是说牧师不重要。

sentences.en: They play a crucial role.
sentences.zh: 他们扮演着至关重要的角色。

sentences.en: And it's important for us to have them play their role as doctors are also supposed to play our role in the health and well-being of folk.
sentences.zh: 重要的是让他们发挥他们的作用，就像医生也应该在人们的健康和福祉中发挥我们的作用一样。

sentences.en: So again, just to drive that point for the mechanics, I say you don't want to have the wrong person looking at your car.
sentences.zh: 所以再说一次，为了强调机械师的那个观点，我说你不会想让错误的人检查你的车。

sentences.en: You don't want to have someone who doesn't have the appropriate skill sets looking at your mind, looking at your heart, looking at your body.
sentences.zh: 你不会想让一个没有适当技能的人去审视你的思想、你的内心、你的身体。

sentences.en: And what I often get pushed back on more than anything is that while going to a primary care physician is OK, going to a mental health professional is not.
sentences.zh: 我最常受到的反驳是，去看初级保健医生是可以的，但去看心理健康专业人士是不行的。

sentences.en: And so I extended a bit again to say we're simply popping the hood.
sentences.zh: 所以我再次延伸了一点，说我们只是在打开引擎盖。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So everything else might be about fixing other elements of you.
sentences.zh: 所以其他一切可能都是关于修复你的其他部分。

sentences.en: But when we're talking about mental health, we're popping the hood.
sentences.zh: 但当我们谈论心理健康时，我们是在打开引擎盖。

sentences.en: We're getting a sense of what's going on in your brain, what's going on in your mind.
sentences.zh: 我们正在了解你的大脑里发生了什么，你的思想里发生了什么。

sentences.en: What can we do to help out a bit more with the way that you're thinking?
sentences.zh: 我们能做些什么来更好地帮助你的思维方式？

sentences.en: So I try to use strategies like analogies to talk to folks.
sentences.zh: 所以我尝试使用类比这样的策略来与人们交谈。

sentences.en: Sometimes it works.
sentences.zh: 有时它有效。

sentences.en: And hopefully with the grandmas in the church that I was at, it works, too.
sentences.zh: 希望对于我在教堂里见到的那些祖母们，它也有效。

sentences.en: And it's like a specialiSt.
sentences.zh: 这就像一位专家。

sentences.en: I mean, if you had heart disease, you'd go to a cardiologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你有心脏病，你会去看心脏病专家。

sentences.en: If you have a mental health condition, you see somebody who treats mental health.
sentences.zh: 如果你有心理健康状况，你会去看治疗心理健康的人。

sentences.en: You do, Kent.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，肯特。

sentences.en: But the one thing that I'll say that I missed this last time is the reason why people keep it in-house.
sentences.zh: 但我最后要说的一点是，我上次漏掉的，是人们把它留在内部的原因。

sentences.en: So I think it's really important to acknowledge that in the past, if you said, I have something that I'm concerned about, that I'm worried about, that's angering me,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为承认这一点非常重要：在过去，如果你说“我有什么担心的、忧虑的、让我生气的事情”，

sentences.en: there could be consequences in your job, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，可能会对你的工作产生后果。

sentences.en: So if you're trying to tell someone, they might look at you as incompetent, or why did we hire this person?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你试图告诉某人，他们可能会认为你无能，或者为什么要雇佣这个人？

sentences.en: Particularly, again, from a lens of if you think about historical consequences.
sentences.zh: 特别是，如果你从历史后果的角度来考虑的话。

sentences.en: If one was enslaved and said, I'm not feeling well, we learned very early on that you could not complain.
sentences.zh: 如果一个人被奴役并说“我感觉不舒服”，我们很早就知道你不能抱怨。

sentences.en: There was no time to reSt.
sentences.zh: 没有时间休息。

sentences.en: There was no time to take time for yourself.
sentences.zh: 没有时间为自己留出时间。

sentences.en: So imagine the luxury then of the descendants of these ancestors in common parlance to be able to sit for an hour and talk about your feelings.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下，这些祖先的后代在日常生活中能够坐下来谈论一个小时你的感受，这是一种怎样的奢侈。

sentences.en: That's not something that historically has always been afforded to Black people.
sentences.zh: 这在历史上并不是一直给予黑人的东西。

sentences.en: So I think it's really important to acknowledge the historical impact and what that has done.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为承认历史影响以及它所造成的结果非常重要。

sentences.en: And I think it's a this and, and we do have services and opportunity now to do this.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个“既……又……”的问题，我们现在确实有服务和机会来做这件事。

sentences.en: And it is not a luxury, it is something that we hope becomes a right, a privilege, something that you take up, something that you want and desire, and we'll be happy to provide it.
sentences.zh: 这不是一种奢侈，它是我们希望成为一种权利、一种特权的东西，是你去争取、去想要和渴望的东西，我们很乐意提供它。

sentences.en: So one of the challenges that we face in psychology is having a diverse workforce, I mean, having appropriate providers available.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在心理学面临的挑战之一是拥有多元化的劳动力，我的意思是，拥有可用的合适提供者。

sentences.en: APA's most recent data found that the psychology workforce is becoming more diverse, but that 83% of psychologists are white,
sentences.zh: 美国心理学会（APA）的最新数据显示，心理学劳动力正变得更加多元化，但83%的心理学家是白人。

sentences.en: compared with only about 60% of the population as a whole.
sentences.zh: 而总人口中只有约60%是这样。

sentences.en: How important is it to have a diverse mental health workforce?
sentences.zh: 拥有一支多元化的心理健康工作队伍有多重要？

sentences.en: It's incredibly important, Kim.
sentences.zh: 这非常重要，Kim。

sentences.en: And it's not because the data on matching, for example, says that we have to have Black therapists with Black clients.
sentences.zh: 这并不是因为匹配方面的数据显示，比如我们必须为黑人客户匹配黑人治疗师。

sentences.en: So for those that may not be available or, excuse me, informed on what matching is, matching is just you have the same race, therapists, or it could go to other identities, right?
sentences.zh: 对于那些可能不了解或——抱歉——不知道什么是“匹配”的人来说，匹配只是指你们有相同的种族，治疗师，或者也可以指其他身份，对吧？

sentences.en: But in this case, if we're talking race, there's not a great deal of data demonstrating that you have to have race consistent matching for your therapeutic outcomes to be high,
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，如果我们谈论的是种族，并没有大量数据证明你必须进行种族一致的匹配才能获得良好的治疗效果，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: So I'm not suggesting that there has to be a match.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不是建议必须进行匹配。

sentences.en: But what I am suggesting is that throughout the training of these therapists, if you don't have diverse thought in the classroom, diversity in practice,
sentences.zh: 但我建议的是，在这些治疗师的整个培训过程中，如果课堂上没有多元化的思想，实践中没有多元化，

sentences.en: if you don't have a number of ways to think about how we might be able to treat clients in a clinic,
sentences.zh: 如果你没有多种方式来思考我们如何在诊所中治疗客户，

sentences.en: then we're missing out on opportunities of addressing challenges in different ways, right?
sentences.zh: 那么我们就错失了以不同方式解决挑战的机会，对吧？

sentences.en: So I certainly think the training atmosphere, generally speaking, would be beneficial or would be benefited by having folk of diverse backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 所以我当然认为，总的来说，拥有多元化背景的人会对培训氛围产生积极影响，或者从中受益。

sentences.en: I can certainly think about it from the perspective of clients seeing me and saying out loud, wow, her hair curls like mine or like, wow, she looks like me.
sentences.zh: 我当然可以从客户的角度来思考，他们看到我时会大声说：“哇，她的头发卷得跟我一样”，或者“哇，她看起来跟我很像”。

sentences.en: Like hearing that is really important for things that we may not be measuring.
sentences.zh: 听到这些对于我们可能无法衡量的事情来说真的很重要。

sentences.en: So how long are people staying in therapy?
sentences.zh: 那么人们在治疗中停留多久呢？

sentences.en: How many referrals do we get because of that?
sentences.zh: 我们因此获得了多少转诊？

sentences.en: So those are some of the things we may not be picking up on that are beneficial as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这些也是我们可能没有注意到但同样有益的事情。

sentences.en: We get a lot of snowball referrals from people within the same community once they see who's at the practice, right?
sentences.zh: 一旦人们看到诊所里的人是谁，我们就会从同一个社区的人那里得到很多滚雪球式的转诊，对吧？

sentences.en: So I think that that's incredibly important too.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这也极其重要。

sentences.en: And I would be remiss if I didn't acknowledge some of the barriers that present itself to going into the professional space.
sentences.zh: 如果我不承认进入专业领域所面临的一些障碍，那就是我的失职。

sentences.en: So I know I always said I wanted to be a psychologist when I was very young, but I didn't really know how to become one.
sentences.zh: 我记得我小时候总是说我想成为一名心理学家，但我真的不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: I didn't know anyone in Detroit who practiced.
sentences.zh: 我在底特律不认识任何从事这个行业的人。

sentences.en: That just wasn't something we talked about or did, right?
sentences.zh: 那根本不是我们谈论或做的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: So I just, I don't know why I put my finger on it, but I was like, I want to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是——我不知道为什么我认定了这一点，但我当时就是想成为一名心理学家。

sentences.en: When you're talking about how much grad school may cost for some people, how much internship applications might cost,
sentences.zh: 当你谈到研究生院对某些人来说可能花费多少，实习申请可能花费多少时，

sentences.en: when you really sit down in total what people might be spending to get to the other side of this
sentences.zh: 当你真正坐下来计算人们为了走到这一步可能花费的总额，

sentences.en: versus someone who may be in a more precarious financial situation that needs to get a job quickly,
sentences.zh: 与那些可能处于更不稳定的经济状况、需要尽快找工作的人相比，

sentences.en: even if it's $45,000, $50,000 for their family, that might mean the world, right?
sentences.zh: 即使对他们的家庭来说是4.5万或5万美元，那也可能意味着全世界，对吧？

sentences.en: And so taking that money back and saying, this is my contribution versus I'm going to go into debt to get this lucrative career later on down the road.
sentences.zh: 所以，把那笔钱拿回来，说“这是我的贡献”，而不是“我以后要背负债务来获得这个有利可图的职业”。

sentences.en: So it's things like that where the APA, for example, needs to be mindful of how do we start investing in people very early on?
sentences.zh: 所以，像美国心理学会（APA）这样的机构需要注意，我们如何从很早开始就对人才进行投资？

sentences.en: And how can we create opportunities for folks who may be financially disadvantaged to come into our profession?
sentences.zh: 我们如何为那些经济困难的人创造机会进入我们的行业？

sentences.en: So we were talking a moment ago about two years since the killing of George Floyd.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才谈到了乔治·弗洛伊德被杀已经两年了。

sentences.en: And even as we're speaking now, there are headlines about another black man being killed by police, Patrick Loyoya in Grand Rapids.
sentences.zh: 即使在我们现在交谈时，头条新闻里还有另一名黑人被警察杀害，即大急流城的帕特里克·利奥亚。

sentences.en: Maybe this is an unfair question and it's a little bit seat of the pants more than research based.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一个不公平的问题，而且比起基于研究，它更多是即兴的。

sentences.en: But do you feel like we're making any progress in the last few years in addressing racism and discrimination and trauma as a society?
sentences.zh: 但你是否觉得作为社会，我们在过去几年里在解决种族主义、歧视和创伤方面取得了一些进展？

sentences.en: Oh, Kim, you are putting me in the hot seat here.
sentences.zh: 哦，Kim，你这是在让我难堪啊。

sentences.en: So I am not as optimistic as some people might be with respect to our direction.
sentences.zh: 对于我们的方向，我并不像某些人那样乐观。

sentences.en: And it's simply because from a sociological view, we're watching the pendulum swing back and forth when we think about progress.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是因为从社会学角度来看，当我们思考进步时，我们正在观察钟摆来回摆动。

sentences.en: And we can start in more recent times with perhaps the election of Barack Obama,
sentences.zh: 我们可以从最近的时期开始，也许是巴拉克·奥巴马的当选，

sentences.en: where there was so much hope and optimism coming from that and the immediate backlash of the subsequent administration.
sentences.zh: 当时人们对此充满了希望和乐观，但随后的政府却立即出现了反弹。

sentences.en: From there, there may have been a pendulum swing again with respect to 2020.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，关于2020年，钟摆可能又摆动了一次。

sentences.en: And now we're watching CRT and that pendulum swing back, the anti-CRT initiative.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们正在目睹批判性种族理论（CRT）和钟摆的摆回，即反CRT倡议。

sentences.en: So we're watching what happens when we try to make progress.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在观察当我们试图取得进步时会发生什么。

sentences.en: And that swift, not reversal, I don't think that's fair either, but a swift softening or quieting or removal of that progress in certain spaces.
sentences.zh: 那种迅速的——我不认为是逆转，我觉得那样说也不公平——但那种在某些领域对进步的迅速软化、压制或消除。

sentences.en: But the optimist in me always does say this, Kim, that what we might consider insanity and that term or the logic around insanity,
sentences.zh: 但我内心乐观的一面总是说，Kim，我们可能认为的疯狂，以及关于疯狂的那个术语或逻辑，

sentences.en: that you have to do the same thing twice expecting different results, right?
sentences.zh: 即你必须做同样的事情两次却期待不同的结果，对吧？

sentences.en: That common adage.
sentences.zh: 那句通俗的谚语。

sentences.en: One of the things that occurred to me in 2020 was that while systems might think that individuals are insane for resisting it, for going out into the streets, for marching,
sentences.zh: 2020年我意识到的一件事是，虽然体制可能认为个人因抵制它、走上街头、游行、

sentences.en: for protesting, for demanding justice, it is actually the systems that are insane for thinking that we will be quieted, for thinking that we won't be the ones demanding justice.
sentences.zh: 抗议、要求正义而疯狂，但实际上，认为我们会安静下来、认为我们不会成为要求正义的人，这才是体制的疯狂。

sentences.en: So that is where I do think the power of the people is still very present and showing, even if there is a pendulum swing, even if there is resistance,
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我确实认为人民的力量仍然非常存在并显现出来的地方，即使有钟摆摆动，即使有阻力，

sentences.en: even if we're not making the type of progress or the pace of progress that many of us hoped we would see after 2020,
sentences.zh: 即使我们没有取得许多人在2020年后希望看到的那种进步或进步速度，

sentences.en: what we did witness was that no amount of suppression would keep us down.
sentences.zh: 我们所见证的是，任何程度的压制都无法让我们屈服。

sentences.en: We're watching right now, some elections where four years ago, there was an attempt to suppress some of the abilities of folks in Georgia to vote a certain way or to have rights.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在观察一些选举，四年前，有人试图压制佐治亚州民众以某种方式投票或拥有权利的能力。

sentences.en: And we're seeing what happens when that pendulum swings back for people to stand up and say,
sentences.zh: 我们看到了当钟摆为人们站出来说“不”而摆回来时会发生什么，

sentences.en: you thought it was going to, the pendulum would stick in one direction, but we're actually bringing it back to come our way.
sentences.zh: 你以为钟摆会停在一个方向，但我们实际上正在把它拉回来，朝着我们的方向。

sentences.en: So in essence, I was hoping that we would see more progress, that magically racism would be over, that my job would be complete and I could go to a beach and relax a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，我曾希望我们能看到更多的进步，希望种族主义能奇迹般地结束，我的工作能完成，我可以去海滩放松一下。

sentences.en: But we are certainly seeing that people are not satisfied with anti-CRT policies or blatant racism, blatant white nationalism.
sentences.zh: 但我们当然看到人们对反CRT政策或公然的种族主义、公然的白人至上主义并不满意。

sentences.en: We're seeing that people are not satisfied with that and are resisting and pushing back.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们对此并不满意，正在抵制和反击。

sentences.en: So getting back to your work then as a psychologist, what is next on the horizon for you?
sentences.zh: 那么回到你作为心理学家的工作，你接下来的前景是什么？

sentences.en: What do you think are the big questions in your area that still need to be answered?
sentences.zh: 你认为你所在领域中还有哪些重大问题需要回答？

sentences.en: Well, I thought I was clear when I said the beach, but let me try to give you something else if that's not satisfactory.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我以为我说海滩时已经很清楚了，但如果那不能让你满意，让我试着给你点别的。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I think that embrace, we were one week away from launching in Detroit, launching a larger study in Detroit when the pandemic hit.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为“拥抱”（Embrace），我们在底特律启动一项更大规模研究的前一周，疫情爆发了。

sentences.en: So it's been a really challenging two years trying to get the data that we need to extend the work.
sentences.zh: 所以这两年为了获得扩展工作所需的数据，真的非常具有挑战性。

sentences.en: But that will be next, trying to get larger samples so that if we're showing the proof of concept that we imagine we're showing from the pilot,
sentences.zh: 但这将是接下来的工作，尝试获得更大的样本，这样如果我们展示了我们在试点中想象的概念证明，

sentences.en: that we'll be able to put this intervention to scale, that we'll be able to bring it to scale and get it to more hands, more people, more houses in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们就能够将这种干预措施扩大规模，能够将其推广并传达到美国更多的手中、更多的人、更多的家庭。

sentences.en: So in alignment with that,
sentences.zh: 所以与此一致的是，

sentences.en: we're trying to think about what are the things that we know would be beneficial right now and how do we collaborate with the APA to create some resources for adolescents online?
sentences.zh: 我们正在思考我们现在知道哪些是有益的，以及我们如何与APA合作，为青少年在线创建一些资源？

sentences.en: How do we create training for practitioners online and make that into a resource?
sentences.zh: 我们如何为从业者在线创建培训并将其转化为资源？

sentences.en: So we're trying to take elements from this much bigger intervention and say we know that this is effective.
sentences.zh: 所以我们正试图从这个更大的干预措施中提取要素，并说我们知道这是有效的。

sentences.en: How do we get bits and pieces of it out into the world?
sentences.zh: 我们如何将其点滴传达到世界上？

sentences.en: So that's the big work that I'm doing over the next year or two.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我在未来一两年内要做的重大工作。

sentences.en: And then the subsequent work is how do we learn better about what this discrimination experience is doing to children through things like VR experiences?
sentences.zh: 随后的工作是，我们如何通过虚拟现实（VR）体验等方式，更好地了解这种歧视经历对儿童的影响？

sentences.en: So we've developed already a classroom experience along with the MIT former doc student.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经与麻省理工学院的一位前博士生一起开发了一种课堂体验。

sentences.en: She developed this narrative around a teacher in a classroom setting discriminating against a child.
sentences.zh: 她围绕一名教师在课堂上歧视一名儿童开发了这个叙事。

sentences.en: And now we're developing with Detroit public school students that narrative for policing and what impact that has on our black children.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正在与底特律公立学校的学生一起开发关于警务的叙事，以及这对我们的黑人儿童有什么影响。

sentences.en: When they put on this VR headset, we're getting this gestural experience.
sentences.zh: 当他们戴上这个VR头显时，我们得到了这种手势体验。

sentences.en: So what are they gesturing?
sentences.zh: 那么他们在做什么手势？

sentences.en: What are what's their heart rate doing?
sentences.zh: 他们的心率在做什么？

sentences.en: What are they looking at?
sentences.zh: 他们在看什么？

sentences.en: What are they feeling beyond just pen and paper?
sentences.zh: 除了纸笔之外，他们感受到了什么？

sentences.en: I'm nervous, right?
sentences.zh: 我很紧张，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm anxious.
sentences.zh: 我很焦虑。

sentences.en: So we're getting so many different metrics and ways of thinking about discriminatory experiences.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得到了许多不同的指标和思考歧视经历的方式。

sentences.en: And that's the next thing after that.
sentences.zh: 这就是那之后接下来的事情。

sentences.en: Yeah, that sounds exciting.
sentences.zh: 听起来很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And for people who can't participate right now in the program that you have, where where might they go to get some resources that can help parents,
sentences.zh: 对于现在无法参加你项目的那些人，他们可以去哪里获取一些可以帮助家长的资源，

sentences.en: especially when they have to have the talk?
sentences.zh: 特别是当他们必须进行“那次谈话”时？

sentences.en: Yeah, so definitely wanting to highlight what the American Psychological Association's Resilience Initiative.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以一定要强调美国心理学会的“韧性倡议”（Resilience Initiative）。

sentences.en: That's Racial and Ethnic Socialization.
sentences.zh: 那是“种族与民族社会化”（Racial and Ethnic Socialization）。

sentences.en: That's what the RES stands for.
sentences.zh: 这就是RES所代表的含义。

sentences.en: So if you type in Resilience Initiative, APA, you'll be able to find a number of age-appropriate worksheets, books, videos, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你输入“韧性倡议，APA”，你就能找到许多适合年龄的工作表、书籍、视频等。

sentences.en: So definitely a shout out to APA for that.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要为APA点赞。

sentences.en: There are a number of other organizations that have it as well, including my partners, Embrace Race, Sesame Street, PBS.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他组织也有这些资源，包括我的合作伙伴“拥抱种族”（Embrace Race）、《芝麻街》、PBS。

sentences.en: Yes, there are so many spaces that have these.
sentences.zh: 是的，有太多的空间拥有这些资源了。

sentences.en: So please don't think that these resources aren't compiled in some way.
sentences.zh: 所以请不要认为这些资源没有以某种方式汇编起来。

sentences.en: All of these wonderful organizations that just indicated have things ready to go by age and even by, again, your relationship to the child.
sentences.zh: 所有这些我刚才提到的优秀组织都有按年龄甚至按你与孩子关系分类的现成资源。

sentences.en: So maybe parent, maybe teacher, but it's there.
sentences.zh: 所以也许是家长，也许是老师，但它就在那里。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And we can put links to some of these in the program notes when we get this posted on the website.
sentences.zh: 当我们把这些发布在网站上时，我们可以在节目说明中加入其中一些的链接。

sentences.en: And thank you for promoting APA and doing my job for me today.
sentences.zh: 感谢你今天为APA做宣传，替我完成了工作。

sentences.en: You're welcome, Kim.
sentences.zh: 不客气，Kim。

sentences.en: So it was great talking to you, Dr. Anderson.
sentences.zh: 很高兴与你交谈，Anderson博士。

sentences.en: I really appreciate the work that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 我非常感谢你所做的工作。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Likewise, and have a wonderful rest of your day.
sentences.zh: 同样，祝你余下的一天过得愉快。

sentences.zh: 你可以在我们的网站 www.speakingofpsychology.org 或你获取播客的任何地方找到《心理学谈话》（Speaking of Psychology）之前的剧集。
